name: Café Treff
beschreibung: The holiday apartment Café Treff is situated in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser in Tirol. The spacious flat features a fully equipped kitchen and a comfortable living area. Guests can unwind on a private balcony or terrace with mountain views. The surrounding Wilder Kaiser mountain range offers superb hiking trails in summer and varied winter sports, making this property an ideal base for outdoor adventures.
